item.description: CONNECTICUT (WTNH) -- DoorDash has cancelled their deliveries Sunday night due to the blizzard hitting the state. item.title: Nearly all Monday flights at Bradley Airport canceled due to blizzard

item.title: Lamont declares state of emergency, issues commercial vehicle ban ahead of storm
